summary.headline: Codex C. VII, 15 Contents
summary.text: Catalogue entry for Codex C. VII, 15, a composite 15th–16th-century manuscript in eight hands, describing astrological, astronomical, liturgical, and divinatory contents. It includes methods for finding Easter, astronomical tables and planetary and solar cycles, a letter by Nikephoros Gregoras to Demetrios Kabasilas, chiromancy, lots, Pythagorean divination, the zodiac and its 36 decans, and notes on Constantinople.
